title: Artificial Intelligence in Cyber Crime
example_note:
With the rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in combating and investigating cybercrimes, it has become increasingly essential to equip faculty members, researchers, Law Enforcement and Government Professionals, with the necessary knowledge and practical exposure in this domain. In this context, NFSU Goa proposes to organize a One-Day Workshop on “Artificial Intelligence in Cyber Crime” in Offline mode on 27 January 2026 at the NFSU Goa Campus.

The workshop aims to bring together participants from diverse backgrounds including faculty, researchers, law enforcement and Government Professionals to exchange knowledge, explore emerging AI-based methodologies, and enhance skills relevant to cybercrime prevention and investigation.

Approval is kindly sought to conduct the above-mentioned Workshop at NFSU Goa and to allocate the necessary budget of approximately Rupees: 40,000/- (Forty Thousand Only).
